name: plain-solidity-bug-patterns
skills: The same reviewer with no knowledge files: a control for what the knowledge adds. Solidity vulnerability patterns, class by class: reentrancy in all variants, denial of service and griefing, input validation and arithmetic, unsafe casts, external call safety and weird ERC-20 tokens, state invariants, guard consistency, oracles and flash loans, signature replay, proxies. Shows the
examples: Does this contract have reentrancy, in any variant?
Can someone block withdrawals or make this function run out of gas?
